summary: CRITICAL BLOCKER: Authentication flow completely broken - unable to test any features. Signup and login both failing to establish user sessions, blocking all feature testing including 7 Levels Deep WHY cascade, Chief Aim, and persistence tests.

backend_issues.notes: Backend /api/auth/signup endpoint returns 200 OK and successfully creates users in Supabase. Backend is functioning correctly.

critical_bugs.issue: Signup completes on backend (200 OK) but frontend fails to establish Supabase session. After calling backend /api/auth/signup successfully, the subsequent supabase.auth.signInWithPassword() call fails with 400 error from Supabase token endpoint.
critical_bugs.impact: BLOCKS ALL TESTING - Users cannot create accounts or login, making the entire application unusable
critical_bugs.error_details: Supabase error: 'Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 400 () at https://dhxkwacdzmwwnmokmppf.supabase.co/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password'
critical_bugs.root_cause: After backend creates user via admin.auth.admin.create_user() with email_confirm: True, the frontend immediately tries to sign in with supabase.auth.signInWithPassword() but Supabase returns 400. Possible timing issue or user not fully created in Supabase auth system.
attempted_fixes: Tried multiple signup attempts with different emails
Extended wait times after signup (up to 10 seconds)
Verified backend is returning 200 OK for signup
Checked backend logs - no errors, user creation succeeds

critical_bugs.issue: Login form submits but fails with 400 error from Supabase, even for accounts that were successfully created on backend
critical_bugs.impact: Users cannot login to existing accounts

integration_issues.issue: Backend signup succeeds but frontend session is never established. User stays on /signup page instead of being redirected to /dashboard

passed_tests: Backend successfully creates users in Supabase
Frontend signup form renders correctly with all fields
Navigation between signup and login pages works
action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix authentication flow before any feature testing can proceed. The signup/login flow is completely broken - backend creates users successfully but frontend cannot establish Supabase sessions. Investigate why supabase.auth.signInWithPassword() fails with 400 error immediately after admin.auth.admin.create_user() succeeds. Possible solutions: (1) Add delay between user creation and sign-in attempt, (2) Use admin API to generate session token instead of password-based login, (3) Check Supabase project settings for email confirmation requirements, (4) Verify Supabase service key permissions. Once auth is fixed, re-run testing for 7 Levels Deep WHY cascade, Chief Aim section, persistence, and ERR_ABORTED bug verification.
